description.narrative: EaP Nätverket arbetar för stärkt samarbete mellan svenska civilsamhällesorganisationer och civilsamhällesorganisationer i Östraparternskapsregionen med syfte att främja demokratisk utveckling, pluralistiska samhällen och samarbete med EU.

The EaP Network works for strengthened cooperation between Swedish civil society organizations and civil society organizations in the Eastern Partnership region with the aim of promoting democratic development, pluralistic societies and cooperation with the EU.

The objective of the intervention is to:
Ensure the sustainability and local ownership of the EaP Network by fostering strategic partnership and enhancing its capacity to support collaboration, advocacy, and the advancement of human rights, democracy, and sustainable development beyond the phase-out period.

The network's success during previous Sida-supported phases lies primarily in the fact that it has succeeded in establishing a network of Swedish civil society organizations with partners in the Eastern Partnership (EaP) countries. These organisations and their partners have to some extent strengthened their capacity through the network's activities. The coordinator has played a significant role in the success and existence of the network.
The focus in recent years has been on influencing, above all, Swedish decision-makers when it comes to policy towards the EaP region. During Sweden's Presidency of the Council of the EU, the Network received funding from the Ministry for Foreign Affairs for activities focusing on civil society and EaP.
While in previous years a number of documents were produced where the network's/civil society's position was clarified and in a concrete way provided input to decision-makers, the activities in 2022-2023 have mostly consisted of the coordinator having meetings with a number of actors with some exchange of information, as well as having discussions with various actors.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
